visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a rapid montage of animation and meme clips including a green character with a paper bag on its head, SpongeBob characters screaming 'Bald!', and a group of bald men in tank tops. (2) A young man with black hair and a cream-colored sweater sits in a home setting with warm lighting, speaking directly to the camera with active hand gestures. (3) A brief shot of a different male in a blue jacket speaking in a hallway, followed by a movie clip of an actor (Christian Bale) adjusting a hairpiece in front of a mirror. (4) The main character returns to show close-ups of his thinning hair from multiple angles, highlighting the scalp under bright indoor lighting. (5) He arrives at '植診所' (Le Bourgeon) wearing a white t-shirt and black bag, walking into a modern medical clinic. (6) Inside, he undergoes a consultation with a female doctor in a white coat, looking at microscopic scalp images on a monitor. (7) The doctor draws zones on his shaved scalp using a plastic template and marker in a bright clinical environment. (8) He is shown during the procedure lying under a red LED light therapy machine wearing dark goggles and white earbuds. (9) Post-procedure, he is at home playing video games, sleeping, and taking a shower where water hits his head directly. (10) He is seen driving a red go-kart with the number 70 on a track, then concludes outside the clinic touching his hair and smiling at the camera.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 禿頭一直都是許多人面臨的問題. [Variety]: 禿頭. (2) [Subtitle]: 禿頭～. (3) [Subtitle]: 而我從小就知道我總有一天也無可避免這樣的命運. (4) [Subtitle]: 因為家裡從我爸那一輩以上的男性長輩全都禿頭 無一例外. (5) [Subtitle]: 果然, 我從25歲就開始掉髮. (6) [Subtitle]: 但是我弟到現在都還沒事 可能是抽到基因樂透. (7) [Subtitle]: 總之我之前就做過一次植髮 但可能是我自己沒有保養好 後來又掉了一些. (8) [Subtitle]: 在此鄭重向各位宣導 植髮不代表一勞永逸 還是要認真吃藥並且定期回診保養. (9) [Subtitle]: 很多人都發現我髮量愈來愈少 常常收到影片留言的「善意」提醒. (10) [Subtitle]: 尤其一些角度看起來就非常亮 即使有個好髮型看起來也不一定有精神. (11) [Subtitle]: 於是, 我決定再次嘗試 這次換去「植診所」. [Logo]: 植診所 LE BOURGEON. [Slogan]: 這次換去「植診所」. (12) [Subtitle]: 會選擇這裡 是因為實際體驗後 流程非常仔細 從一開始的醫師諮詢之外. (13) [Subtitle]: 還有用儀器特寫拍攝頭皮 分析每個區域的髮量. (14) [Subtitle]: 之後才決定要從哪裡移植頭髮 並且種到哪些範圍. (15) [Subtitle]: 總共移植 3521 根. (16) [Subtitle]: 而手術當天也是非常順利 我就在那邊趴了幾個小時 體感時間過得很快. (17) [Subtitle]: 就連打麻醉的時候都沒有感受到痛感. (18) [Subtitle]: 結束後他們非常仔細告訴我要怎麼照顧 什麼東西不能吃 生活要做什麼改變. (19) [Subtitle]: 看來我以後不能熬夜了 也要注意讓自己不要壓力太大. (20) [Subtitle]: 還有給我專用的乾式溫和洗髮精 以及預防雄性禿的藥. (21) [Subtitle]: 回到家之後幾乎沒有感覺 只有後面傷口感覺有點緊緊的. [Variety]: TIGHT. (22) [Subtitle]: 而且隔天就可以洗頭了 十天之後又把植髮處的痂搓掉 幾乎是無縫接軌回到日常生活. (23) [Subtitle]: 沒過幾天還跑去開卡丁車 真的很期待之後頭髮完全長回來的樣子 到時候再跟大家分享.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Personal Story -> Problem -> Solution (Endorsement) -> Result/Recovery.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a personal testimonial and promotion for a specific hair transplant clinic. It follows a classic vlog narrative structure, starting with a humorous/relatable hook about baldness, sharing the creator's failed past experiences, and then providing a detailed walk-through of a successful, professional experience at the endorsed clinic to build trust and offer a solution to the audience.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator specifically names '植診所' (Le Bourgeon), shows the exterior and interior of the clinic, details the consultation and surgical process, and mentions specific hair counts and aftercare products provided by the clinic.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High production value with professional voiceover and meme-style editing likely designed for high engagement on platforms like TikTok or Instagram Reels. The blend of humor and medical documentation creates a persuasive endorsement.
